summary: Newton Golf Company filed an 8-K disclosing a September 23, 2026 Assignment and Assumption Agreement with Spartan Crest Capital and Cannon Bridge Mining Services. Newton assumed an exclusive option to acquire 100% of the Pole Canyon Project, 16 unpatented lode claims covering roughly 330 acres in White Pine County, Nevada. Newton issued Spartan Crest designees stock equal to 19.9% of pre-closing shares outstanding, assumed $200,000 cash option payments ($165,000 unpaid) and $200,000 in share consideration, plus a 2.0% net smelter royalty. Spartan Crest gains two board designees and one officer role; a resale registration statement is due within 45 days. Watch dilution, royalty overhang, and mining execution risk.
